document.abstract: At the Society's recent Annual Technical Conference in October, many excellent papers were presented on a variety of themes including, Networked Media in the Facility; Video Compression; Developments in Audio Technology (including Immersive Audio, and Loudness); File-Based Workflows; Wide Color Gamut; Higher Frame Rates; Cinema Workflows; Asset Management; The IP Connected World—Control, Monitoring and Production; The Evolution of Broadcast Facilities; Video Display Technologies; and Advancements in Theatrical Display. Many of these papers underlined the important role that Standards play in the successful deployment of these technologies in our industry. It was also obvious to me that our work in writing interoperable standards is not done, and in fact, is more important than ever.
